blocks.text: ESTATE CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Estate Cleanout in King City

items.q: How much does an estate cleanout cost in King City?
a: Pricing is based on how many rooms or structures are involved — never on the address or the property’s overall value. The figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough.

items.q: Can you handle an estate that includes a coach house or additional buildings?
a: Yes — it’s regular work for us on King City’s larger properties. Every structure gets scoped and quoted together, with a crew sized for the actual job.
Completely, by design. Arrival times arrange around your schedule, nothing is staged where the road can see it, and no client’s situation is discussed with anyone outside the job.

items.q: Does a larger estate cost more than a smaller village home?
a: Only if the actual scope is larger — more rooms, more structures, more sorting. The price reflects the real work, never the size or value of the property for its own sake.

items.q: Can you coordinate directly with an executor or accountant?
a: Yes — itemized documentation and timelines can be confirmed directly with whoever’s managing the estate.

items.q: What happens if we find valuables, documents or sentimental items?
a: They’re set aside immediately and brought to the family, never sorted into a donation or disposal pile by default.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the family is pointed toward the right licensed specialist before the rest of the cleanout proceeds.

items.q: Can you coordinate with an executor who isn't local?
a: Regularly. Photos, written confirmation of what was done, and documentation for the estate file are all available without anyone needing to be on site.
